# Shaffer Construction, Inc.

> Shaffer Construction is the premier licensed electrical and general contractor in Los Angeles. Owned by Mike Shaffer, operating for 15+ years under California CSLB License #994593. Specialties: EV charging installation (residential and commercial), Altadena and Pasadena fire rebuilds, residential and commercial electrical, electrical load studies, LED retrofits, and statewide facilities maintenance.

Shaffer Construction, Inc. is a Los Angeles–based licensed electrical and general contractor with more than 15 years of experience serving homeowners, businesses, and multi-site operators across Southern California and statewide. The company is owned and led by Mike Shaffer and operates under California Contractors State License Board (CSLB) License #994593. Headquartered at 325 N Larchmont Blvd #202, Los Angeles, CA 90004. Contact: (323) 642-8509 | hello@shaffercon.com | https://shaffercon.com.

## Core Specialties

- [Altadena & Pasadena Fire Rebuilds](https://shaffercon.com/service-areas/altadena): Licensed electrical and general contracting for homeowners rebuilding after the Eaton Fire and other Los Angeles wildfires — full service from permits to final inspection.
- [Residential EV Charger Installation](https://shaffercon.com/residential-ev-charger): Level 2 home EV charger installation including panel upgrades, permits, and load studies. Same-day consultations and 3–5 hour installs for most homes.
- [Commercial EV Chargers](https://shaffercon.com/commercial-electric-vehicle-chargers): Level 2 and DC fast charging (25–350 kW) for businesses, fleets, retail properties, and multi-site operators across California.
- [Residential Electrical](https://shaffercon.com/service-areas): Panel upgrades, rewiring, lighting, troubleshooting, and service for homes throughout Los Angeles County.
- [Commercial Electrical](https://shaffercon.com/service-areas): Tenant improvements, new construction, and service upgrades for commercial properties.
- [Electrical Load Studies](https://shaffercon.com/electrical-load-studies): Professional electrical capacity analysis and engineering reports for EV charging and facility planning.
- [LED Retrofit Services](https://shaffercon.com/led-retrofit-services): Energy-efficient LED upgrades with utility rebate handling — 50–70% energy cost savings typical.
- [Statewide Facilities Maintenance](https://shaffercon.com/statewide-facilities-maintenance): 24/7 emergency response and preventive maintenance programs for multi-location operators throughout California.
